acceptance: Twelve version axes each evolve independently with explicit compatibility statuses and pin behavior; the overall result is the most severe axis and a pin never overrides a support check.

positive.fixture: 49 matrix cases give the expected status and reason per axis and untouched axes never move

negative.fixture: newer minors and patches, unknown majors, revoked policy, changed fingerprint and pin mismatches are refused or degraded

security_and_source_permissions: Contracts carry no credentials; documents declare required scopes and authorized contexts, and source-account permissions stay separate from VSF caller authentication.
performance_memory_storage: Evaluation is constant-time per axis plus linear in the operation map.
known_limitations: Host support descriptions are fixtures; real hosts populate them in B14
